```yaml
name: Run Bun Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  bun-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Start local testnet
        run: pnpm run testnet:start
        env:
          APTOS_TESTNET: true

      - name: Wait for testnet to be ready
        run: sleep 30

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies with Bun
        run: bun install

      - name: Run Bun tests
        run: bun test

      - name: Stop local testnet
        if: always()
        run: pnpm run testnet:stop
```
